mapper.select: SELECT id, profile_key, built_in, enabled, active_version, last_version, revision, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_agent_profile WHERE profile_key = #{key} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, profile_key, version_no, status, definition_json, definition_fingerprint, published_at, published_by, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_agent_profile_version WHERE profile_key = #{key} AND version_no = #{version} FOR UPDATE

SELECT v.id, v.profile_key, v.version_no, v.status, v.definition_json, v.definition_fingerprint, v.published_at, v.published_by, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.created_by, v.updated_by FROM manga_agent_profile p JOIN manga_agent_profile_version v ON v.profile_key = p.profile_key AND v.version_no = p.active_version WHERE p.enabled = TRUE AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manga_agent_profile (profile_key, built_in, enabled, last_version, revision, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{key}, TRUE, TRUE, 0, 0, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE profile_key = profile_key
